name: Wishing well bush
stage1: The wishing well bush seed has just been planted.
stage2: The wishing well bush grows larger and begins to grow leaves near the ground.
stage3: The wishing well bush grows larger, and its bulb is no longer at ground level.
stage4: The wishing well bush grows larger and begins to lean noticeably.
stage5: The wishing well bush grows larger still and begins to open up.
stage6: The wishing well bush opens up completely and is ready to harvest.
